Can't help with that. Aim assist and radar hacks for a competitive game read process memory, inject into or hook the game, and are designed to bypass anti-cheat — that's the same category as a game cheat/exploit, and it actively harms other players in ranked matches.

Happy to help with legitimate game-related code, Win32 systems work, or anything else you're building.
